is_mandatory.quote: A person or qualifying officer for a corporation or member of a residential builder or residential maintenance and alteration contractor shall not bring or maintain an action in a court of this state for the collection of compensation for the performance of an act or contract for which a license is required by this article without alleging and proving that the person was licensed under this article during the performance of the act or contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of a contract, construction project, or operation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment without legal excuse of a contract, construction project, or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion of funds or property received for a specific construction project to other uses.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project or operation, or for a specified purpose in the prosecution or completion of a construction project or operation, and the funds or property application or use for any other construction project or operation, obligation, or purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to account for or remit money belonging to others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to account for or remit money coming into the person's possession that belongs to others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in a material respect without proper consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in a material respect and prejudicial to another, without consent of the owner or an authorized representative and without the consent of the person entitled to have the particular construction project or operation completed in accordance with the plans and specifications.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of the building laws of this state or a political subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A willful violation of the building laws of this state or of a political subdivision of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the lender the purchaser's signed completion certificate upon completion of work under a residential maintenance and alteration contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In a residential maintenance and alteration contract, failure to furnish to a lender the purchaser's signed completion certificate executed upon completion of the work to be performed under the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the department within 10 days of a change in control or direction of the business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to notify the department within 10 days of a change in the control or direction of the business of the licensee resulting from a change in the licensee's partners, directors, officers, or trustees, or a change in the control or direction of the business of the licensee resulting from any other occurrence or event.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to deliver to the purchaser the entire agreement of the parties including any finance or other charge.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to deliver to the purchaser the entire agreement of the parties including any finance or other charge arising out of or incidental to the agreement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Salesperson's failure to immediately pay over money received in connection with a transaction to the employing licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a salesperson, failure to pay over immediately upon receipt money received by the salesperson, in connection with a transaction governed by this article to the residential builder or residential maintenance and alteration contractor under whom the salesperson is licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the article or allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade this article, or knowingly combining or conspiring with, or acting as agent, partner, or associate for an unlicensed person, allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Salesperson accepting commission or other valuable consideration from a person other than the employing licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acceptance of a commission, bonus, or other valuable consideration by a salesperson for the sale of goods or the performance of service specified in the article from a person other than the residential builder or residential maintenance and alteration contractor under whom the person is licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Becoming insolvent, filing bankruptcy, failing to satisfy judgments or liens, or failing to pay obligations as due.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Becoming insolvent, filing a bankruptcy action, becoming subject to a receivership, assigning for the benefit of creditors, failing to satisfy judgments or liens, or failing to pay an obligation as it becomes due in the ordinary course of business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Workmanship not meeting the standards of the Michigan residential code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Workmanship not meeting the standards of the Michigan residential code as promulgated under the Stille-DeRossett-Hale single state construction code act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing violation of the asbestos abatement contractors licensing act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department may suspend or revoke that person's license for a knowing violation of the asbestos abatement contractors licensing act

definition_quote.value: "Residential builder" means any of the following: (i) A person engaged in the construction of a residential structure that, for a fixed sum, price, fee, percentage, valuable consideration, or other compensation, other than wages for personal labor only, undertakes with another or offers to undertake, or purports to have the capacity to undertake with another, for the erection, construction, replacement, repair, alteration, or addition to, subtraction from, improvement, wrecking of, or demolition of, a residential structure.
definition_quote.quote: "Residential builder" means any of the following: (i) A person engaged in the construction of a residential structure that, for a fixed sum, price, fee, percentage, valuable consideration, or other compensation, other than wages for personal labor only, undertakes with another or offers to undertake, or purports to have the capacity to undertake with another, for the erection, construction, replacement, repair, alteration, or addition to, subtraction from, improvement, wrecking of, or demolition of, a residential structure.

methods_authorized.quote: A license includes the following crafts and trades: carpentry; concrete; swimming pool installation; waterproofing a basement; excavation; insulation work; masonry work; roofing; siding and gutters; screen or storm sash installation; tile and marble work; and house wrecking.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: A licensee shall, as part of the contract, provide information relating to his or her individual license and to any license issued to that person as a qualifying officer of another entity.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: A person that is working on 1 undertaking or project by 1 or more contracts, if the aggregate contract price for the labor, material, and any other items for the undertaking or project is less than $600.00.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: The department shall issue the license of a residential builder and residential maintenance and alteration contractor for a period of 3 years in duration.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
scope__voidable_contract_clauses.quote: A person or qualifying officer for a corporation or member of a residential builder or residential maintenance and alteration contractor shall not bring or maintain an action in a court of this state for the collection of compensation for the performance of an act or contract for which a license is required by this article without alleging and proving that the person was licensed under this article during the performance of the act or contract.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
